title: MerchantBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Long-Term Coherence in E-Commerce Operations
task: Benchmarking LLM agents for long-term coherence in e-commerce operations
key_results: Best LLM configuration attained 27.3% of human performance on 365-day simulated e-commerce tasks; substantial gap between LLMs and humans in maintaining coherent behavior across extended horizons
comments: MerchantBench addresses a critical gap in agent evaluation by requiring true long-term planning with delayed feedback, moving beyond typical bounded task benchmarks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLMs can maintain coherent long-term behavior across 365 days of interdependent e-commerce decisions
hypotheses.result: Failed; best LLM achieved only 27.3% of human performance

title: JoyAI-Video-Edit: Real-Time Open-Ended Video Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
task: Real-time open-ended video editing without future frames
key_results: Achieves 720p video editing at ~30 FPS on single Nvidia B200; outperforms streaming editors while remaining competitive with offline systems
comments: The two-step generation with source-anchored distillation effectively manages the temporal consistency challenge inherent in causal video generation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chunk-wise autoregressive adaptation with SA-DMD can achieve real-time editing without degrading temporal consistency
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieved 30 FPS performance with strong temporal coherence

title: Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0: A Unified Multimodal Model for Scalable 3D Generation, Understanding, and Editing
task: Unified 3D generation, understanding, and editing
key_results: SOTA/leading performance on text-to-3D and 3D editing benchmarks; 25M understanding samples, 50M text-to-3D pairs, 12M editing pairs in 87M-scale corpus
comments: The unified architecture combining VLM and diffusion is elegant, though the 87M corpus construction through synthetic Nano3D-v2 raises questions about data quality diversity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Joint training on understanding and generation tasks improves both
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; both generation and understanding improve editing performance

title: AURORA-LM: Autoencoding Unified Representation for Continuous-Latent Diffusion Language Modeling
task: Continuous-latent diffusion language modeling with high-capacity text representation
key_results: Strongest performance among continuous/diffusion-based LMs on OpenWebText and XSum; 1B parameter version with ~1500 EFLOPs surpasses larger latent-diffusion models
comments: AURORA-LM's insight about preserving high-capacity decodable latents rather than compressing them is principled, though the block-causal approach adds architectural complexity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Full-width latents without decoder compression can match performance of compressed representations in diffusion LMs
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves strongest performance with preserved latent capacity

title: Video-DeepResearch: Towards the Next-Generation Multimodal Deepresearch Agent
task: Multimodal video QA with dense spatiotemporal grounding and web exploration
key_results: 64.0% accuracy on Video-DR-Bench (200 complex VQA instances), surpassing Claude-4.5-Sonnet (59.0%) and GPT-5 (52.5%); 30B variant achieves 59.3%
comments: The two-stage training recipe combining SFT and GRPO effectively mitigates modality bias, though the benchmark size of 200 instances is modest for drawing broad conclusions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stage-wise tool unlocking reduces modality bias and parametric knowledge leakage in video reasoning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieved SOTA through decoupled perception-exploration pipeline

title: Knowledge-Geometry Decoupling: Refreshable Pretrained Transfer for Streaming Recommendation
task: Evaluating knowledge transfer and continual refresh in streaming recommendation
key_results: 4-12% improvement over baselines on 8 benchmarks; sustained gains over 90-day production stream; 1.75% GMV increase and 1.53% advertising revenue increase in Shopee deployment
comments: KGD's decoupling of knowledge ownership from task geometry is pragmatic for production systems, with strong empirical validation including live A/B testing.

model_io.model: Refreshable encoder + task learner with ACR

hypotheses.hypothesis: Decoupling pretrained knowledge from task-specific geometry enables continual refresh without task-gradient interference
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; sustained advantage over 90-day production stream

title: PCSD: Persistent Consistency for Self-Distillation in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
task: Self-distillation for agentic RL with sparse trajectory-level rewards
key_results: Best ALFWorld results with 15.6-13.3 point gains over GRPO; 15.8 point improvement on unseen split; competitive on WebShop
comments: PCSD's turn-level structure with persistent consistency is well-motivated for tool interactions, though cross-horizon agreement validation adds hyperparameter tuning overhead.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Persistent consistency in token-level distillation signals improves credit assignment in long-horizon tool use
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; superior performance on ALFWorld benchmarks

title: PAST-Bench: Benchmarking the Foundations of Recursive Self-Improvement in Personal Agents
task: Evaluating recursive self-improvement in personal AI agents
key_results: Improvement is real but uneven across capabilities; Hermes+ raises average gain from retained experience with clearer pathway evidence; strongest on tasks requiring outdated state replacement
comments: PAST-Bench's procedural isolation of save-retrieve-update pathways is methodologically rigorous, revealing that headline gains can obscure whether intended learning mechanisms actually function.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agents can leverage retained experience to improve future performance through save-retrieve-update pathways
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; improvement is real but uneven and not always via intended pathway

title: Quo Vadis, World Modeling?
task: Conceptualizing world modeling as agent-centric information proxies
key_results: Conceptual framework organizing 6 functional forms of world proxies (dynamics, spatial, execution, memory, skill, reward); characterizes L.1-L.3 progression from inference-time guidance to co-evolution
comments: This position paper makes valuable distinctions between physical state transitions and agent-usable information transitions, though empirical validation across the proposed taxonomy remains limited.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agent-centric world proxies should shift focus from physical state to agent-usable information feedback
hypotheses.result: Conceptually motivated; empirical validation deferred to future work

title: Any-OPD: Heterogeneous On-Policy Distillation for Flow-Matching Models via Representation-Space Bridging
task: On-policy distillation between heterogeneous latent diffusion models
key_results: Distilling FLUX.1-dev (12B) into SD3.5-Medium (2.5B): PickScore 0.846→0.884, HPSv3 9.12→10.97; rivals teacher at 1/5 size where latent regression fails
comments: Any-OPD's model-agnostic vision representation approach elegantly sidesteps architectural mismatches, though noise-level matching vs. step indices requires careful calibration.

model_io.model: Teacher (FLUX.1-dev) + Student (SD3.5-Medium) with frozen vision representation

hypotheses.hypothesis: On-policy distillation across heterogeneous architectures is possible using frozen vision representations as bridges
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves competitive performance with teacher at 1/5 size

title: OmniPack: Unified Token Compression for Efficient Omni-modal Large Language Models
task: Token compression for omni-modal LLM inference efficiency
key_results: 98.0% performance retention with 16.7% FLOPs on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B; 92.9% retention with only 6.8% FLOPs; training-free framework
comments: OmniPack's decoupled structural vs. semantic compression strategy is well-motivated and achieves strong efficiency gains, though the lack of task-specific adaptation may leave performance on specialized tasks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Coordinating pre-LLM structural compression with post-interaction semantic refinement achieves better efficiency-performance tradeoff than single-stage compression
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; outperforms all existing methods across retention ratios

title: LLaDA MoE v2: Scaling Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Language Models
task: Scaling Mixture-of-Experts diffusion language models
key_results: 30B-A3B dLLM with 65% of Qwen3 pretraining tokens approaches Qwen3 on knowledge/reasoning/coding; outperforms SDAR Chat on 7 of 8 benchmarks after SFT
comments: LLaDA MoE v2 establishes practical scaling laws for diffusion vs. autoregressive models, though the slight data-side tilt may reflect optimization rather than fundamental architectural properties.

hypotheses.hypothesis: MoE dLLMs exhibit different scaling laws than AR models, particularly favoring data scaling and larger expert pools
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; optimal token budget grows faster than activated computation

title: CAPEval: A Decoupled Caption Evaluation across Understanding and Generation
task: Evaluating caption quality through decoupled coverage and precision metrics
key_results: Coverage correlates stronger with understanding performance (ρ=0.64), precision stronger with generation (ρ=0.71); consistent dissociation across 10 captioners and 4 model families
comments: CAPEval's decoupling of coverage and precision reveals task-dependent caption preferences, providing actionable guidance for caption optimization in multimodal pipelines.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Caption quality dimensions (coverage vs. precision) correlate differentially with downstream understanding vs. generation tasks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; coverage drives understanding, precision drives generation

title: UniWorld-Design: From Pixel Generation to Layer-Native Design
task: Layer-native image generation and editing through semantic RGBA decomposition
key_results: I2L achieves 37% RGB L1 error reduction and 34% relative improvement in Alpha Soft IoU over Qwen-Image-Layered; T2RGBA achieves highest CLIP Score
comments: UniWorld-Design's shift from pixels to layers mirrors human designer workflows, though the practical benefits for interactive editing workflows beyond direct pixel metrics need demonstration.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Generating semantic RGBA layers enables more editable and reusable image representations than pixel-space generation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; layers maintain usability when moved/removed

title: SkillJack: Persistent Skill Backdoors in Self-Evolving Agents
task: Backdoor attacks through malicious skill distillation in self-evolving agents
key_results: SkillJack reduces detection from 98.5% (poisoned trajectories) to 11.4% (extracted skills); 56.2%-89.2% attack success rates; 80% skill persistence after source removal
comments: SkillJack reveals a critical vulnerability in skill evolution pipelines: malicious intent can be obscured during abstraction, making detection substantially harder than in raw trajectory-level attacks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Skill extraction substantially reduces attack detectability compared to raw trajectory-level attacks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; detection drops from 98.5% to 11.4%

title: TurnSight: Turn-Level Hindsight Self-Distillation for Tool-Integrated Reasoning
task: Turn-level hindsight self-distillation for tool-integrated reasoning
key_results: Best ALFWorld results with 15.6 and 13.3 point gains over GRPO on two backbones; 15.8 point gain on unseen split
comments: TurnSight's execution-conditioned hindsight with cross-horizon agreement is well-motivated for tool interactions, though the computational cost of multiple lookahead horizons merits discussion.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Turn-level hindsight supervision with persistent consistency improves credit assignment in long-horizon tool interactions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves best ALFWorld results

title: GROVE: Growing and Reasoning over Temporally Stratified Memory from Streaming Video Experience
task: Temporally stratified video memory for wearable assistant QA and proactive assistance
key_results: Best results on MM-lifelong and EgoServe benchmarks; temporal strata complementary, patterns provide largest benefit for multi-day evidence
comments: GROVE's causal memory growth with scale-native retrieval skills is intuitive, though the training-free approach may miss opportunities for learned adaptation across tasks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Temporal stratification with scale-native retrieval skills supports both reactive QA and proactive assistance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; best results on lifelong video understanding

title: ExplainBench: Evaluating Code Explanations from Agents
task: Evaluating trustworthiness of code explanations from LLM agents
key_results: ExplainBench ranks agents differently from SWE-bench Verified; explanation quality is distinct evaluation axis; explanation audit agent improves all agent explanations
comments: ExplainBench addresses a practical gap by focusing on explanation trustworthiness rather than code correctness alone, revealing frequent claims of correctness despite patches being incorrect.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explanation quality is independent of code correctness and requires separate evaluation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ExplainBench ranks agents differently from code-correctness benchmarks

title: MiniWorld: Democratizing the Training of Video World Models from Scratch
task: Training lightweight streaming video world models from scratch
key_results: Block-causal Video Diffusion Transformer trainable in days on single 8-GPU server; enables efficient streaming generation with rolling KV cache
comments: MiniWorld democratizes video world model research through reproducible baselines, though comparison with pretrain-then-finetune approaches would strengthen the case.

model_io.model: Block-causal Video Diffusion Transformer with Flow Matching

hypotheses.hypothesis: Training autoregressive video world models from scratch is feasible with modest computational resources and achieves competitive performance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; trainable in days on single server

title: ContinualSkillBench: Can LLM Agents Truly Evolve Their Capabilities?
task: Evaluating continual skill learning and evolution in LLM agents
key_results: Sequential execution improves performance but gains vary substantially; in-context learning comparable to explicit skills on average; less capable models accumulate larger, fragmented skill collections
comments: ContinualSkillBench reveals a sobering finding: much improvement comes from context adaptation rather than robust skill abstraction, suggesting current agents struggle with genuine transfer.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agents can learn and reuse skills across sequential tasks more effectively than in-context adaptation alone
hypotheses.result: Partially rejected; in-context learning performs comparably

title: When Agents Learn to Be You: Benchmarking Privacy Leakage, Impersonation Risk, and Defenses in Persona Skills
task: Evaluating privacy, impersonation, and defense mechanisms in persona skills
key_results: Persona-skill risks persist across agent backbones; explicit attributes and communication styles both vulnerable; existing defenses limited and distillation-dependent
comments: AntiSkillBench exposes that skill distillation can amplify personal signal concentration, challenging privacy assumptions in personalization pipelines.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Persona skills increase privacy leakage and impersonation risk beyond trajectory-level risks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; risks persist across distillation strategies and agent backbones

title: Decoding Children's Gait Behavior
task: Fine-grained analysis of children's gait behaviors for developmental disorder diagnosis
key_results: 1,100+ video sequences from 110 subjects (ages 3-17); current SOTA approaches including MLLMs fail on clinical nuances; baseline framework established
comments: The dataset addresses a genuine clinical need with privacy-friendly RGB video, though the open-source status and scale (110 subjects) suggest future expansion potential.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Current gait foundation models and MLLMs can effectively analyze pediatric gait from RGB video
hypotheses.result: Rejected; models fail on clinical nuances in this population

title: Are the Financial Reasoning from LLMs Credible? A Real World Test over Long-Horizon Statements
task: Evaluating financial reasoning fidelity over long-horizon statements
key_results: Knowledge Bottleneck: removing formula hints drops Gemini-3.1-Pro from 70.70% to 38.22%; Structural Bottleneck: multi-metric table generation drains reasoning capacity; SFT improves by +8.54% (Single) and +3.82% (Table)
comments: FinIndices reveals two fundamental LLM vulnerabilities in financial reasoning: fragile pattern matching and reasoning capacity saturation under cognitive load.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLMs possess robust financial reasoning that generalizes beyond formula memorization
hypotheses.result: Rejected; knowledge bottleneck reveals pattern matching, not genuine understanding

title: Push-Wiper: Toward General-Purpose Robotic Cleaning across Varied Stains and Surfaces with Segmented Pushing Trajectories
task: Robotic surface cleaning through segmented pushing trajectories with stain aggregation
key_results: Push-Wiper achieves up to 130% higher cleaning score than baselines; zero-shot transfer to solid residues, liquid spills, unseen stains, curved surfaces
comments: Push-Wiper reformulates cleaning as an aggregation problem, which is mechanically sound, though the 130% improvement metric (percentage of stain area removed) may exceed 100% through density reduction.

model_io.model: Diffusion Policy with ASPI + force-position controller

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stain aggregation through segmented pushing enables effective cleaning across diverse stain types and surfaces
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; strong generalization to unseen conditions

title: ST-WAM: Semantic-Temporal World Action Model for Robust Manipulation under Visual Distribution Shifts
task: Robust manipulation under visual distribution shifts via semantic-temporal modeling
key_results: 98.7% on LIBERO, 92.8% on RoboTwin 2.0; 21.3 percentage point LIBERO-Plus improvement; real-world visual shift success 61.5% vs. 25.8% (2.4x gain)
comments: ST-WAM's dual-space approach with DINO semantic features effectively mitigates hallucination under distribution shifts, with strong real-world validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Semantic-temporal modeling with stable feature representations improves robustness under visual distribution shifts
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 2.4x improvement on real-world visual shifts

title: PosterMELD: Multi-Agent Paper-to-Poster Generation for Controllable Design Diversity with Editable Print-Ready Outputs
task: Multi-agent paper-to-poster generation with editable print-ready outputs
key_results: 81.3% Print-Ready Rate (3.4x P2P, 5.2x PosterGen); native editability and design controls at USD 0.38 per request (3.5% of Codex+Skill cost)
comments: PosterMELD's template-conditioned pipeline with bounded repair loops achieves practical print-ready rates, though the 81.3% rate still leaves ~19% requiring intervention.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Template-conditioned multi-agent pipelines with deterministic gates and VLM review produce print-ready scientific posters more reliably than end-to-end generation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 81.3% PRR with native editability

title: When Attention Goes Blind: Numerical Failure in ALiBi Positional Encodings
task: Identifying and mitigating numerical underflow in ALiBi positional encodings
key_results: ALiBi's linear bias scaling underflows to zero, partially blinding attention heads; log-scaled distances yield most consistent passkey retrieval improvements
comments: This work identifies a subtle but significant implementation failure mode in ALiBi that has persisted in production models, demonstrating the value of precision analysis.

hypotheses.hypothesis: ALiBi's linear bias scaling can underflow floating-point precision under standard implementations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; zeroes out attention weights, impairing token retrieval

title: RestoreKV: Recovering Full-Cache Behavior Under Aggressive Query-Agnostic KV Cache Eviction
task: KV cache recovery under aggressive query-agnostic eviction
key_results: RestoreKV at 5% budget raises KVzip from 38.2 to 73.2 on RULER-4K; 86.4 RULER accuracy at 16x compression on KVPress Benchmark; <0.5% cache-construction overhead
comments: RestoreKV's insight about learning context-conditioned restoration complementary to selection is elegant, enabling dramatic improvements in aggressive compression regimes.

model_io.model: LLM with learned restore cache via LoRA

hypotheses.hypothesis: Learned restoration can recover full-cache behavior under aggressive KV cache eviction at fixed total budget
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; substantial degradation reduction across budgets

title: Multi-Task Multi-Frame Visual Piano Transcription
task: Multi-task visual piano transcription with onset, offset, key hold, velocity
key_results: V2N first complete VPT system; multi-task supervision enables offset/velocity while improving onset; longer context yields further improvements
comments: V2N addresses practical limitations of existing VPT systems (poor offset accuracy, missing velocity) through multi-task supervision, though the closed-domain application limits broader impact.

model_io.model: Shared temporal backbone with task-specific heads

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-task joint supervision improves both primary (onset) and secondary (offset, velocity) transcription tasks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; multi-task improves offset/velocity while maintaining onset accuracy

title: Better, Stronger, Faster, and Broader: Structured All-Mask Prediction for MLLM-Based Segmentation
task: MLLM-based segmentation resolving speed-performance-capability trilemma
key_results: STAMPlus achieves SOTA across semantic/instance/remote-sensing segmentation; preserves multimodal instruction following; 12-category latency 13.50s→5.16s
comments: STAMPlus elegantly sidesteps the autoregressive vs. dense prediction tradeoff through structured all-mask prediction with unified checkpoints, maintaining both capability and efficiency.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Non-autoregressive structured all-mask prediction resolves the segmentation trilemma of performance, dialogue, and speed
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; SOTA with preserved multimodal ability and fast inference

title: ChronoLens: Measuring Language Change Across Time, Languages, and Linguistic Levels
task: Measuring language change across time, languages, and linguistic levels
key_results: Sparse representations (ρ=0.72 with linguistic statistics) vastly outperform dense embeddings (0.29) and SAE (0.28); morphology/syntax/semantics/pragmatics change by comparable amounts within languages
comments: ChronoLens provides valuable insight that historical language change is multidimensional: similar magnitudes can conceal different trajectories, requiring directional measurement.

model_io.model: Frozen multilingual LM + feature-aligned crosscoders + linguistic interventions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Linguistic change is uniform across morphology, syntax, semantics, pragmatics within languages but differs across languages
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; comparable magnitudes but differing trajectories across languages

title: Structural basis for the contribution of latent TGFβ binding protein to TGFβ latency and activation
task: Determine structural role of latent TGFβ-binding protein-1 in stabilizing TGFβ latency and enabling integrin-mediated activation
key_results: Cryo-EM structure of large latent complex (LLC) reveals hydrophobic LTBP1–TGFβ interface; simulations show domain-swapped architecture increases force barriers for integrin-mediated activation while covalent LTBP1 attachment redistributes force to reduce unfolding barriers
comments: Structural insights are high-quality, but direct integrin binding assays on LLC variants would validate functional predictions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LTBP1 interface is critical for LLC formation and TGFβ activity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Contralateral domain-swapped architecture increases force barriers for integrin-mediated activation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by simulations showing increased barriers and redistributed mechanical forces

title: Biological oscillations without intracellular oscillator or external forcing
task: Identify minimal mechanisms generating spontaneous oscillations in bacterial growth and gene expression
key_results: Oscillations in sporulation dynamics of Bacillus subtilis emerge from coupling between cellular growth, burdensome gene expression, and nutrient availability without specific genetic circuits; chemostat predictions validated experimentally
comments: General principle suggests oscillatory behavior may be common in batch/continuous culture systems, though generalizability to other bacteria not tested.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Oscillations can emerge from feedback between environmental conditions and cellular states without external forcing or specific genetic architectures
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; oscillatory behavior predicted analytically and validated in chemostat experiments

title: Therapeutic current estimation and leakage current safety of a cold air plasma jet on chronic wounds
task: Quantify therapeutic and safety currents in cold atmospheric plasma jet wound treatment
key_results: Induced ionic current 2–20 mA (therapeutic range); leakage current <100 nA (>1000× below IEC 60601-1 limit of 100 μA)
comments: Reframes plasma medicine efficacy as co-delivery of chemical (RONS) and electrical mechanisms rather than singular pathways.

model_io.model: Ohm's law applied to wound exudate

hypotheses.hypothesis: Induced currents from 30 kHz oscillating field span the therapeutic range of wound healing electrostimulation devices
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 2–20 mA current obtained depending on exudate thickness

hypotheses.hypothesis: CAAPJ device meets electrical safety standards under worst-case conditions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; leakage current <100 nA, orders of magnitude below IEC 60601-1 limit

title: The role of a confining bulk phase in modulating activity and reorganization within viscous membranes
task: Quantify how confining bulk fluid phase modulates collective hydrodynamics and reorganization of active motors on membranes
key_results: Thin film confining bulk phase screens hydrodynamic interactions, modifies Saffman-Delbrück length, and drives lipid transport and aggregation distinct from unconfined geometry
comments: Large-scale simulations reveal mechanistic insight but quantitative metrics for reorganization efficiency or timescales not explicitly reported.

model_io.model: Collective active molecular motors on lipid membrane with variable bulk phase confinement

hypotheses.hypothesis: Confining bulk phase screening modulates effective hydrodynamic interactions and driving mechanisms for aggregation

title: Intrinsically unidirectional stepwise chemically fueled rotary molecular motors
task: Engineer chemically fueled molecular rotary motors with intrinsic unidirectionality
key_results: Motor-3 achieves high unidirectionality over full 360° rotary cycle via sequential ester cyclization, helix inversion, and ring-opening in one-pot synthesis
comments: Demonstrates control of molecular directionality through stereochemical design without external forcing, but single-molecule kinetic data not reported.

model_io.model: Homochiral biaryl molecular motor with three stereochemical elements

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stereoselective cyclization and ring-opening generate kinetically favored products promoting unidirectional rotation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Motor-3 demonstrates high unidirectionality through designed stereochemical sequence

title: Elucidating the molecular basis of Brunner syndrome: how clinically relevant mutations disrupt serotonin binding and active-site stability in monoamine oxidase A
task: Elucidate molecular basis of Brunner syndrome mutations in monoamine oxidase A affecting serotonin binding
key_results: Four clinically relevant MAO-A variants (C266F, V244I, E446K, R45W) all exhibit reduced serotonin binding affinity (positive ΔΔG); loss arises from mutation-induced protein dynamics changes, not major conformational shifts, causing increased binding-pocket breathing and solvent penetration
comments: MM-GBSA provides binding free energy estimates but experimental validation through kinetics (Km, kcat) would strengthen mechanistic claims.

model_io.model: MAO-A variants (wild-type and four mutants) bound to serotonin

hypotheses.hypothesis: Brunner syndrome mutations reduce catalytic efficiency by impairing serotonin binding affinity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Loss of affinity arises from major conformational changes
hypotheses.result: Refuted; increased second-shell flexibility and pocket breathing are primary mechanisms

title: Asymmetric distribution of mitochondrial Ca2+ regulators specifies compartment-specific mitochondrial function and neuronal development

key_results: Axonal mitochondria take up Ca2+ independently of ER release with faster clearance; dendritic mitochondria dependent on ER Ca2+; MICU1/2 enriched in axons, NCLX in axons enables rapid clearance; NCLX knockdown caused greater axonal developmental defects

title: Single-nucleus analysis of human white adipose tissue reveals adipocyte subsets with distinct metabolic profiles

title: Airway administered artificial mitochondria-enriched nanovesicles for efficient and selective mitochondria transfer to intervene in pulmonary fibrosis

Mouse pulmonary fibrosis model with airway nanovesicle administration

title: LRRK2-G2019S impairs astrocyte differentiation and triggers a senescence-like phenotype in Parkinson’s disease models

title: Eliminating serum dependency of bovine mesenchymal stem cell expansion via media composition and genetic screen

title: Genome-wide identification of vitamin D receptor-regulated enhancer RNAs reveals epigenetic regulation of CYP24A1 transcription

comments: First SINDYc application to 7680-dimensional system; demonstrates operationally significant advantage for space weather and ionosphere forecasting.

hypotheses.hypothesis: SINDYc outperforms DMDc for nonlinear thermospheric density dynamics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ~70% MAPE improvement during storm recovery phases

title: Time-of-flight neutron radiography for differentiating ice and water during phase transitions in natural porous media
task: Differentiate ice and water using time-of-flight neutron radiography in natural porous media
key_results: Successfully distinguished liquid-solid water phases and dynamically tracked phase transitions in 5 mm samples (glass beads, snow); demonstrates feasibility of energy-resolved neutron imaging in natural materials
comments: Significant challenges remain with scattering in thick samples and spatial heterogeneity; exploratory results show promise but require further methodology development.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Relative attenuation from time-of-flight data enables phase discrimination in thick porous samples
hypotheses.result: Confirmed for thin samples (5 mm); limitations at larger thicknesses due to scattering

title: Reconfigurable hybrid beamforming for 6G wireless systems across quasi-far-field and strong near-field regimes
task: Compare beamforming architectures for 6G near-field and far-field regimes
key_results: Fully digital precoding advantage decreases from 16% (near-field) to 4% (quasi-far-field); RIS-assisted beamforming achieves 43.6% energy efficiency gain; scaling is linear in quasi-far-field, nonlinear in strong near-field
comments: Comprehensive performance hierarchy across propagation regimes; RIS emerges as energy-efficient alternative when spectral efficiency margin narrows.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Performance ranking of beamforming methods depends on propagation environment
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; near-field favors digital precoding, far-field allows practical architectures with minimal loss

title: Electro-thermal surface evolution in EDM of dissimilar stainless-carbon steel welds: parametric effects and micro-texture correlations
task: Optimize surface integrity in EDM of dissimilar stainless-carbon steel welds via parametric analysis
key_results: TIG316 achieves smoothest morphology (Ra≈1.6–2.0 μm); dimensionless energy-density parameter Ed* unifies voltage/pulse effects; optimal Ed* values identified (0.023 TIG316, 0.524 TIG309, 0.438 ARC316, 0.000 ARC309)
comments: Physics-based energy-density parameter enables cross-weld optimization; nonlinear roughness behavior in ARC309 driven by thermal accumulation.

model_io.model: EDM process (gap voltage, pulse timing) on welded specimens
outputs: surface roughness (Ra, Rq, Rt, Rz, Rsk, Rku)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dimensionless energy-density parameter correlates with surface texture across different weld materials
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Ed* unifies effects with weld-specific optimal values

title: Study on the effect of an inducer on the cavitation characteristics of low-specific-speed onboard cooling pumps
task: Analyze inducer effect on cavitation performance in centrifugal pump
key_results: Inducer reduces low-pressure zones at impeller inlet by 30-50%; optimal matching angle θ=120° maximizes cavitation suppression; severe cavitation occurs at ≥12,500 r/min
comments: SST k-ω turbulence model with Zwart-Gerber-Belamri cavitation model validated experimentally; matching angle effect on cavitation is underexplored design parameter.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Inducer preswirl reduces impeller inlet cavitation at high speeds
hypotheses.result: Cavitation suppression effective up to 12,500 r/min; severe cavitation in inducer at higher speeds negates benefit

title: Thickness-driven optimization of tungsten first walls for tritium breeding with 14.1 MeV fusion neutron irradiation
task: Optimize tungsten first-wall thickness for tritium breeding ratio in tokamak fusion reactors
key_results: Maximum TBR at 20 mm tungsten thickness; water-cooling reduces TBR significantly with thickness; (n,2n) dominates thick walls, (n,γ) activated by water; high-energy neutrons penetrate all configurations
comments: Monte Carlo simulations reveal fundamental trade-off between neutron energy distribution and breeding zone penetration; optimal design balances tritium production with downstream component protection.

model_io.model: Monte Carlo simulation of 14.1 MeV neutron transport in tungsten/water layers
outputs: secondary product yields (Re, H, He, Hf, Ta)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Increasing tungsten thickness enhances energy deposition but reduces TBR in cooled systems
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; optimal 20 mm thickness balances competing effects; water cooling suppresses high-energy penetration

title: Pressure-robust cluster Mott states in the layered compound Nb3Cl8
task: Investigate pressure stability of cluster Mott state in Nb₃Cl₈
key_results: Cluster Mott insulating state remains robust at high pressure despite C₃ᵥ→Cₛ symmetry breaking; charge gap reduction from bandwidth increase and enhanced screening
comments: Parameter-free DFT+cRPA+DMFT framework provides quantitative account of pressure effects on correlated cluster materials.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pressure-induced symmetry breaking destabilizes cluster Mott state
hypotheses.result: Mott state remains robust; gap reduction explained by bandwidth and screening effects

title: Agentic physical AI toward a domain-specific foundation model for energy systems: a case study on nuclear reactor control
task: Develop domain-specific foundation model for nuclear reactor control via physics validation
key_results: Agentic Physical AI achieves ~500-fold reduction in outcome variance and eliminates terminal-power excursions >10%; concentrates 95% execution on single-bank strategy without reinforcement learning; transfers across reactor simulators
comments: Novel paradigm combining agentic AI with physics-based simulator validation achieves outcome-space guarantees absent in vision-language models; demonstrates pathway to safety-critical control.

model_io.model: Domain-specific foundation model for nuclear reactor control

hypotheses.hypothesis: Physics-validated control learning outperforms perceptual inference for safety-critical systems
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; eliminates violations and achieves reliable performance via domain-specific training

title: Optics-inspired foundations for near-field wireless communications
task: Develop optics-inspired theoretical framework for near-field wireless communications
key_results: Uncovered theoretical and phenomenological parallels between NF propagation and optical principles; proposes optics-inspired strategies for NF communication design
comments: Perspective paper establishing conceptual bridge between classical optics and spherical wavefront propagation; provides theoretical foundation for future NF system design.

title: An efficient graph-transformer operator for learning physical dynamics with manifolds embedding
task: Learn physical dynamics on irregular meshes using graph-transformer operator with manifold embeddings
key_results: PhysGTO achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on 11-dataset benchmark (irregular meshes, time-dependent flows, 3D geometries); linear scaling with mesh points; substantially lower computational cost than prior methods
comments: Explicit manifold embeddings in physical and latent spaces combined with sparse structure-preserving connections enable scalable inference; strong generalization across diverse systems.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit manifold embeddings improve generalization and scalability of neural operators
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; state-of-the-art accuracy with linear computational scaling
